inj.note: Moss has enterted the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and will not return to Sunday's game. Jahdae Barron will likely finish the game at outside cornerback for the Broncos.

news.h: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle, CB Riley Moss suffer concussions against Panthers
news.d: Broncos wide receiver Jaylen Waddle and cornerback Riley Moss both suffered concussions against the Panthers.
